title: Arrays & Collections
explanation: An array holds a fixed number of values of one type: String[] items = {"a", "b", "c"};  Access with items[0], length with items.length.
ArrayList (from java.util) is a resizable list -- add(), get(index), size(), and remove() let it grow and shrink at runtime.
The for-each loop (for (String item : items)) walks every element without needing an index. Try it on both the array and the list below.
